heading: An experienced, effective commissioner.
text: Since joining the Hillsborough County Commission, Harry has focused on the work that matters — strengthening infrastructure, improving transportation, protecting our water supply, supporting essential county services, and standing up for affordable housing.

heading: An experienced, effective commissioner.
text: Important work is already underway. Reelecting Harry means keeping an experienced, effective commissioner on the job and continuing the progress Hillsborough County families are counting on.

heading: What We’re Fighting For
text: Real plans, not slogans — here’s where this campaign is focused.

heading: Transportation & infrastructure
text: Keep projects moving, improve safety, and ease congestion as the county grows.

heading: Water & environment
text: Protect the region’s water supply, natural resources, and environmental future.

heading: Affordable housing
text: Fight for practical housing investments that help families stay in Hillsborough County.

heading: Public safety & services
text: Give first responders and county employees the resources to serve a growing community.

heading: Let’s keep Harry working for us.
text: Volunteer, request a yard sign, or chip in today.
